name: PSX S5
description: Native PlayStation emulator for PS5 with two emulation cores: Beetle PSX HW with Vulkan GPU rendering and PCSX-ReARMed. Supports internal resolutions up to 16x, PGXP geometry correction, save states, memory cards, RetroAchievements, automatic cheats, cover art, per-game settings, scanlines, quick resume and USB game storage. Requires your own game images and, for Beetle PSX HW, your own regional PlayStation BIOS dump.
author: SynoPiia
